summaryZh: Mishanina Lab 研究人类线粒体与细菌中的基因表达调控，包括 RNA 聚合酶暂停、转录与 DNA 复制及 RNA 加工的耦合。研究页面明确采用 SHAPE-MaP、单颗粒冷冻电镜和体外转录实验研究 RNA 结构与转录。
researchQuestions: RNA 聚合酶如何通过暂停调控转录，并在线粒体中协调 RNA 合成、DNA 复制及 RNA 加工？

evidence.quote: Welcome to the Mishanina Lab! We are part of the Department of Biochemistry & Molecular Biophysics at the University of California, San Diego.
We explore how RNA polymerase, the central enzyme in gene expression, regulates transcription through pausing, coordinates RNA synthesis with DNA replication and RNA processing in mitochondria
We are currently investigating the details of this process using chemical probing of RNA structure (SHAPE-MaP), single-particle cryo-EM of transcription complexes, and in vitro transcription assays.
